formula: With all due respect is a fixed polite expression used before a disagreement, correction, criticism, refusal or objection

formulas.formula: With all due respect is a fixed polite expression used before a disagreement, correction, criticism, refusal or objection

example: With all due respect, I disagree with your answer.
exampleZh: 恕我直言，我不同意你的答案。

examples.en: With all due respect, I disagree with your answer.
examples.zh: 恕我直言，我不同意你的答案。
examples.highlight: With all due respect, I disagree with your answer.

rules.zh: 表達禮貌異議時，With all due respect 是固定用語，字詞必須保持相連並依照原有次序；不可把 due 移到 respect 後面或任意省略當中的字詞。
rules.en: Keep the expression together With all due respect is a fixed expression. Do not separate or rearrange its words. With all due respect With all due respect, I disagree. With due all respect, I disagree. With all respect due, I disagree.

rules.zh: 在本練習中，逗號後應直接接完整子句。這個表達本身已經提示聽者，接下來會出現不同意見或負面意見。
rules.en: Do not add “but” immediately after it In this exercise, write a complete clause directly after the comma. Preferred: With all due respect, I disagree. Avoid: With all due respect, but I disagree. The expression already prepares the listener for a contrasting or negative opinion.

rules.zh: 主要句式通常需要一個主語和一個限定動詞。恕我直言，這份報告並不完整。
rules.en: Use a complete clause The main pattern normally requires a subject and a finite verb. With all due respect, the report is incomplete. Subject: the report Finite verb: is

rules.zh: 表達 With all due respect 放在句首時，後面要加逗號；放在主語或情態動詞之後作插入語時，前後都要加逗號；放在句尾時，前面要加逗號。
rules.en: Use commas correctly At the beginning: With all due respect, I disagree. After the subject: Your answer, with all due respect, is incorrect. After a modal: We cannot, with all due respect, accept this condition. At the end: I cannot agree with that, with all due respect.

rules.zh: 這個表達最適合用於說話者即將：【disagree with someone】 不同意別人的看法；糾正一項說法；質疑一項決定；拒絕一項要求；提出一項重要疑慮。在完全正面的陳述前，通常沒有需要使用這個表達。
rules.en: Use it mainly for disagreement or correction This expression is most natural when the speaker is about to: disagree with someone correct a statement question a decision refuse a request raise a serious concern. It is usually unnecessary before a completely positive statement.

rules.zh: 這個表達可以緩和合理的不同意見，但不能令無禮或侮辱性的說話變得可以接受。恕我直言，我認為報告有部分內容需要修改。 即使加上禮貌用語，直接把別人的想法稱為「荒謬」仍可能十分無禮。
rules.en: It does not make an insult polite The expression can soften a reasonable disagreement, but it cannot make rude or insulting language acceptable. Appropriate: With all due respect, I think part of the report needs to be revised. Inappropriate: With all due respect, your idea is ridiculous.

rules.zh: 這個表達屬於正式而克制的用語，但如果說話時帶有憤怒或過分強調的語氣，也可能令人感到諷刺或挑釁。使用時應保持平靜，並在其後提出合理的解釋。
rules.en: Tone matters The expression is formal and controlled, but it can sound sarcastic or confrontational if spoken with an angry or exaggerated tone. Use it calmly and follow it with a reasonable explanation.

benefits.zh: 你不需要突然說「你錯了」或「我不同意」，而是可以先表示自己尊重或理解對方的立場。恕我直言，我認為你的結論沒有足夠證據支持。
benefits.en: It helps you disagree without sounding immediately rude Instead of beginning suddenly with “You are wrong” or “I disagree”, you can first show that you recognise the other person’s position. Direct: Your conclusion is wrong. More controlled: With all due respect, I do not think your conclusion is supported by the evidence.

benefits.zh: 當你需要向經理、老師、主席、官員或資深同事提出不同意見時，這個表達十分實用。恕我直言，我認為這個限期並不切實可行。
benefits.en: It is useful when speaking to someone in authority The expression is helpful when disagreeing with a manager, teacher, chairperson, official or senior colleague. With all due respect, I believe the deadline is unrealistic.

benefits.zh: 聽者會明白你接下來將提出糾正、反對或不同意見，因此不會突然感到意外。
benefits.en: It clearly prepares the listener for disagreement The listener understands that a correction, objection or different opinion is coming.

benefits.zh: 目標表達【With all due respect】可以成為一個現成的開場框架，讓你在說話時有時間組織其後的內容。
benefits.en: It gives you time to organise a careful response With all due respect can act as a ready-made opening while you organise the rest of your answer. With all due respect With all due respect, I think... With all due respect, I am not convinced that... With all due respect, the evidence suggests...

benefits.zh: 在句子中，With all due respect 可以放在句首，亦可放在主語附近作插入語，偶爾也可放在句末。位置改變時要配合逗號把插入語分隔，但禮貌提出異議的功能不變；這種位置彈性能增加說話和寫作的句式變化。
benefits.en: It allows sentence-position variety The expression can appear at the beginning, in the middle or occasionally at the end of a sentence. With all due respect, I disagree. I think, with all due respect, that the plan is too risky. The plan, with all due respect, is too risky. I cannot support the plan, with all due respect.

benefits.zh: 這個表達可用於會議、辯論、面試、正式對話、投訴回覆和專業討論。它應該適量使用，而不應放在每一個不同意見之前。
benefits.en: It is useful in formal discussion and writing The expression can be used in meetings, debates, interviews, formal conversations, complaint responses and professional discussions. It should be used selectively rather than placed before every disagreement.
